name: Thermometer
description: A thermometer whose mercury column rises from the bulb to the top, fits progress-style loading

variations.name: default
variations.description: An outlined thermometer with a mercury column that rises from the bulb to the top in a loop

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Color of the thermometer outline and tick marks

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Fill color of the stem and bulb interior

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
